Enterprise social saw consolidation (Yammer to Microsoft 2012) but no collapse of investment in 2014.

evidence.title: WhatsApp (Wikipedia)
evidence.shows: Facebook announced acquisition of WhatsApp for about US$19 billion, its largest to date: consumer social valuations at a peak, not burst, in 2014.

evidence.shows: Global cost of cybercrime estimated as a wide range ($375bn-$575bn), not a consistent annual series.

verdicts.reading: By 2015 the prices of 80% of cloud services will include a global energy surcharge.

evidence.title: AWS Price Reduction #42 (AWS blog)
evidence.shows: EC2, S3, RDS, ElastiCache and EMR prices cut 10-61%; 42nd price reduction since 2008; no energy surcharge.
